result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide, well-maintained sidewalk separated from the roadway by a buffered zone with delineators. However, the multi-lane road and industrial surroundings with blank frontages create a car-centric atmosphere that lacks permanent safety infrastructure and pedestrian-scale amenities.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Permanent Buffer
hazards.description: The buffer zone relies on temporary delineators rather than permanent physical barriers, offering less protection from errant vehicles.

interventions.title: Permanent Curb Extension
interventions.description: Replace temporary delineators with permanent concrete curbs and planters to provide a more robust physical barrier and improve aesthetics.

interventions.title: Street Trees

interventions.title: Road Diet

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a large, open car dealership lot with an expansive, poorly defined driveway crossing the sidewalk. result.summary: The environment is dominated by a wide, multi-lane arterial road with significant distances between safe crossing points. hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cross a wide expanse of asphalt without any refuge or median.

hazards.name: Frequent Vehicle Conflict Points
hazards.description: Multiple driveways and parking lot entrances on the left side create frequent points where vehicles cross the pedestrian path.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Design
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes with minimal roadside friction encourage high vehicle speeds.

result.summary: The environment is a wide, multi-lane arterial road featuring a newly installed concrete median refuge island but lacking marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. The surrounding land use is commercial and industrial with significant blank frontages and a lack of continuous, buffered sidewalks, creating a hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: A pedestrian refuge island is present in the center of the roadway, but there are no marked crosswalks or signage to facilitate a safe crossing across the multi-lane road.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the concrete island

hazards.name: High-speed road design
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane configuration with minimal roadside friction and long sightlines encourages higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Discontinuous sidewalk network
hazards.description: There is no visible sidewalk on the near side of the street, forcing pedestrians into the roadway or onto unpaved shoulders.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and near side of the street

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings and appropriate signage to connect the refuge island to the sidewalks on both sides of the street.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (PHB)
interventions.description: Install a signalized crossing to provide protected crossing intervals for pedestrians on this wide arterial road.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous sidewalk on the near side of the street to provide a safe, separated walking path for pedestrians.
